_comment: Copy to tools/sanitize-map.json (gitignored) and fill in YOUR real strings on the left. Every left-hand value below is fictional. Replacements are applied longest-first, case-insensitively, to every text node, input value and title attribute on the page before the screenshot is taken. The residual check then fails the page if any left-hand string is still visible.
_amount_factor_note: Every currency amount on the page is multiplied by this factor and re-formatted, so relative sizes hold but no real figure survives. Set to 1 to keep amounts. Balances shown in charts are scaled too because they are rendered as text; SVG axis labels are text nodes as well.
